'''Pan-frying''' was a method of cooking food used by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] in his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Quor'sav-fried steak]] and [[Gamorrean Pork]] were two dishs which were cooked using this method.
